items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 October 2026 10:41pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 01 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland will bring fronts overnight and through tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 to 6, decreasing 4 or 5 for a time early-to-mid morning, then gradually increasing 5 to 7 by mid-afternoon. Veering west 4 or 5 late evening or early tomorrow night.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough around mid-afternoon until late evening. Locally slight in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Showers or rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 late in the night. Then gradually backing south or southwest through Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
